templates.hint: The storefront themes available to your pages. A theme is chosen per page, in the editor's General section.
templates.pagesUsing: {count, plural, =0 {used by no pages} one {used by # page} other {used by # pages}}

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: What needs a person, and how the period is going
overview.overdueHint: Waiting more than {minutes} minutes with no call logged.
overview.attentionHint: Everything here has somebody waiting on it. Each one opens where it gets fixed.
overview.allClearHint: No overdue calls, no unbooked parcels, no stock warnings and no failing integrations.
overview.alertUnbookedHint: The customer said yes and nothing has been handed to a carrier.
overview.alertFollowupHint: Open tasks whose due time has passed.
overview.alertStockOutHint: Confirming an order for these promises a delivery the warehouse cannot make.
overview.alertStockCriticalHint: At or under half the alert threshold — the restock is late, not due.
overview.alertSuspiciousHint: Marked confirmed after a call shorter than the minimum you set.
overview.alertIntegrationHint: Requests that were refused or never completed. An order may not have arrived.
overview.trendHint: The filled part of each bar is what was confirmed.
overview.stockHealthyHint: Every product and variant is above its threshold.
overview.agentPerformanceHint: Bar length is workload; colour is the confirmation rate.
overview.carrierPerformanceHint: Parcels the carrier settled in this period, and how many arrived.
overview.topProductsHint: By order volume, with the confirmed value of each.

order.title: Order
order.auditEmpty: Nothing has been recorded for this order yet.
order.unknownVariant: This variant is not in the catalogue — the level shown is the product's total.
order.noCatalogMatch: No catalogue product matches this line, so stock and revenue counters do not move for it.

clients.title: Customers
clients.editHint: Only these four can be corrected by hand. Every lifetime counter is the sum of order events and cannot be edited.
clients.name: Name
clients.exportHint: The file contains exactly what the filters above select.

products.title: Products
products.noChannels: Not linked to any sales channel.
products.noEvents: Nothing has changed on this product yet.
products.ambiguousHint: Two catalogue rows answer to this name, so an order naming it cannot be attributed to either — its lifetime counters stay still and the sales summary would count its revenue twice. Rename one.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.lowStockHint: Out of stock first, then critically low, then due for a restock. A product with no threshold set can still be out.

carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.adapterUnavailable: Integration unavailable — cannot book or track
carriers.webhookHint: Give this address to the carrier so it can push delivery updates.
carriers.noLogs: Nothing has passed between you and this carrier yet.

channels.title: Sales channels
channels.webhookHint: Paste the webhook URL into the storefront platform. Every inbound delivery — accepted, rejected or unrecognised — is recorded in this channel's log.

finance.title: Finance
finance.appendOnly: Records are kept forever, never edited
finance.versionsHint: A period saved more than once keeps every version. The newest is what the business runs on; the ones under it are what it used to say — almost always a parcel that came back after the first calculation.

agents.title: Agents
agents.payrollHint: Salary is prorated by the period rule; per-order pay counts what actually happened in it.
agents.addElsewhere: People are added to the company on the team screen, not here — this screen sets what each person does and what they are paid.

write.readOnly: You can read this order but not change it.
write.noStartHint: A result logged without starting the call is recorded as such.
write.noteHint: A note joins the history and does not change the order's status.
write.classifyHint: A fake order stays confirmed if it was confirmed. The two are separate facts.
write.parcelHint: Books with the carrier set on this order.
write.refreshHint: Fetches whatever the carrier reports. Safe to repeat.
write.adjustHint: A correction records a change and a reason, never a new total — damage, theft, a miscount.
write.lotHint: A purchase creates its own lot at its own price, and a sale consumes the oldest first — which is what makes the reported margin the real one.
write.maskKeeps: Leave a field as it is to keep the stored key. Typing replaces it.
write.derivedHint: Net profit and margin are calculated by the server, so two people reading the same period cannot see two answers.
write.orderHint: For an order taken by phone. A name or a number is enough to start; the rest can be filled in later.
write.resetPasswordHint: Setting a password signs that person out everywhere, on every company they belong to — the credential changed, not their access to one team.
write.bookingHint: Booking is limited per run to
write.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded.
write.variantsHint: Define the option axes, generate the matrix, then set a level and a photograph per variant. Everything below is saved with the product in one request.
write.costHint: The basis every profit figure is computed from. A product created without it reports a margin that is wrong rather than absent.
write.thresholdHint: Below this, the product is flagged as running low.
write.stockHint: The opening level. Ignored when the matrix below has variants — each one carries its own.

settings.title: Automation rules
settings.atomicHint: An invalid value changes nothing — the whole batch is refused rather than half applied.

reservation.immediate: As soon as the order arrives

settings.fixedCostsHint: Rent, salaries, subscriptions — entered once a month and shared across every period by the proration rule.
settings.noFixedCosts: No fixed costs recorded, so every saved P&L charges nothing for rent or salaries.
settings.channelCarrierHint: Used when an order from that channel names no carrier of its own. The order’s own choice always wins.

queue.title: My calls
queue.followUpHint: Raised when a carrier reports something needing a person. Close it once you have spoken to the customer.

export.title: Export
export.hint: The file contains exactly what the filters above select. Carrier files carry confirmed orders only.

calculator.title: Profit / loss calculator
calculator.subtitle: What the carrier actually paid, against what it should have. Everything here explains that difference.
calculator.syncHint: Overwrites units sold, returns, real revenue, buy price and packaging from delivered orders in this period. Everything else stays.
calculator.noLink: Added by hand — no catalogue product to sync from.
calculator.lossCost: Cost of one lost or damaged unit
calculator.realCa: Real revenue received from the carrier
calculator.breakEvenNever: Never — the unit does not cover itself
calculator.fixedProrated: Fixed costs, prorated to this period
calculator.profitable: The business is profitable over this period.
calculator.losing: The business is losing money over this period.
calculator.breakingEven: The business breaks even over this period.
calculator.saveHint: Saved records are insert-only: saving the same period again keeps the earlier answer.
calculator.incidentsInProductCosts: Returns, exchanges and losses are saved inside product costs, so the stored net profit matches the total above.
calculator.customWarning: A custom range can never be rolled up into a month or a year later — only aligned weeks and months can.
calculator.historyHint: The last 50 records of the selected period type.
calculator.aggregateHint: Adds up the records already saved one level down — weeks for a month, months for a quarter or a year. It reads no orders.
calculator.aggregateOnly: Only a month, a quarter or a year is built out of anything smaller.
calculator.aggregateMissing: No saved sub-period records for this window — save the individual weeks or months first.
calculator.saveAggregate: Save this roll-up as a record

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How many of the people who ordered actually agreed when somebody phoned.
analytics.revenueNote: Confirmed value is what customers agreed to on the phone; delivered value is what the carrier actually paid. Under cash on delivery those are different numbers, and the gap between them is the one worth explaining.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.subtitle: Instant figures from your own data, and the assistants that may read it.
ai.chatUnavailable: Model calls are not enabled on this deployment. Everything above is computed from your own data and needs no provider; a chat box that always failed would say less than this sentence does.
ai.yourCeiling: What an assistant could read for you
ai.name: Name
ai.noProviders: No provider is configured, so nothing here can call a model.
ai.permissionsHint: A request, not a grant: whatever is ticked here is narrowed to what the person ASKING is allowed to see, every time it is used. An assistant can never be a way around a permission.

variants.hint: Define the options, generate the matrix, then set each variant's stock. Every stock change is written to the movement ledger with the reason below.
variants.noVariants: No variants — this product is tracked as one stock line.

import.clientsHint: A CSV of customers. Nothing that already has a value is overwritten, and the lifetime counters are never touched — an imported figure lands in its own column.
import.ordersHint: A CSV of past orders. Rows already imported are recognised by their original order id and skipped, so running the file twice does not double the history.

jobs.title: Run a rule now
jobs.hint: These normally run on a timer. Press one to apply it immediately after changing a threshold above, and see what it did.

error.noCarrier: No carrier is set on this order, so there is nothing to book with.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved.
error.unknownAdapter: This carrier uses an integration this system does not have.
error.addressUnresolved: The carrier does not recognise the address on this order.
error.carrierUnreachable: The carrier could not be reached. Nothing was booked.
error.carrierNoPolling: This carrier only pushes updates, so there is nothing to ask it.
error.tooManyRows: That export is too large. Narrow the filter and try again.

common.noResultsHint: Try widening or clearing the filters.
common.errorHint: The page was attempted once and did not come back. Try again — if it keeps happening, tell whoever runs the platform.
common.pageNotFoundHint: That address does not lead anywhere in this console.
